text: うまれたときから　せなかに　しょくぶつの　タネが　あって　すこしずつ　おおきく　そだつ。

structure.en: from the time it is born

structure.jp: せなかに　しょくぶつの　タネが　あって
structure.en: there is a plant seed on its back, and

structure.jp: すこしずつ　おおきく　そだつ。
structure.en: it grows bigger little by little.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one part of the sentence to the next with 'and'. タネが　あって = 'there is a seed, and'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a phrase means 'when', and から adds 'from'. うまれたときから = 'from when it was born'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く lets a describing word tell how an action turns out. おおきく　そだつ = 'grows big'.
